description: Source file defining functions to generate PDSCH configuration parameters for different RNTI types in 5G NR, including handling of DMRS info, overhead, and resource allocation based on 3GPP TS 38.214 specifications.

methods.name: get_pdsch_config_f1_0_tc_rnti
methods.description: Generates PDSCH config for type 1_0 TC RNTI based on cell configuration and resource allocation.

methods.name: get_pdsch_config_f1_0_c_rnti
methods.description: Overloaded functions generating PDSCH config for type 1_0 C RNTI, with optional serving cell config.

methods.name: get_pdsch_config_f1_1_c_rnti
methods.description: Generates PDSCH config for type 1_1 C RNTI with dedicated DMRS info and resource settings.
